_comment: Intended Vertex AI Agent Engine (Reasoning Engine) registration for the WhyC pipeline — closes hackathon R5 (Agent Builder used). NOT auto-applied: deployment requires a Python agent package; see README.md in this directory. The actual create call goes through vertexai.preview.reasoning_engines.ReasoningEngine.create(...).
description: WhyC — the autonomous build-judge-improve pipeline that, for each Y Combinator company, drafts a product spec (multi-analyzer), generates a Next.js preview manifest (multi-developer), deploys a live Cloud Run preview, scores it with a 5-critic Gemini panel, reads its own Arize Phoenix traces back, and decides whether to re-iterate. Runs as a Cloud Run job; all model calls go through Vertex AI Gemini 2.5 (Flash + Pro); every stage is mechanically gated by the hook layer (see hooks/) and traced to Phoenix Cloud.

class_methods.name: run_company
class_methods.description: Run the full pipeline for one company: analyze → go/no-go → loop(develop → deploy → judge → introspect → self-improve) until converged or ceiling.

parameters.source_url: string — the company's public posting / homepage URL
parameters.body: string — the public posting text (sanitized before any LLM call)

class_methods.returns: { status: 'converged'|'ceiling_hit'|'no_go', iterations, total_cost_cents, final_spec_fit, deployed_services[], run_dir }
